content.short: Backpack is a wallet for xNFTs, a new breed of NFTs with state-evolving capabilities.
content.description: Backpack is a wallet project by Coral, the team behind the Anchor framework for Web3 development. It is designed to be the wallet for xNFTs and to function as the gatekeeper for access, transactions, and identity management in the growing xNFT economy. With Backpack, users can store, send, and collect xNFTs across multiple chains and user platforms, building a unified experience across ecosystems while keeping control over their digital assets.
